pagedata.pyDescription: Accepts Two pages and compare, and prepare a List of properties which possess the difference needed
pagedata.pyUsage: During Flow Execution in recording mode, We capture user entered propeties and their value by comparing the work pages, before and after user enters values. Also properties name started with px and pz are not captured. Properties with empty values are also removed from the final list.
